# Frontline Fire & Flood

Doing business as: Frontline Fire & Flood - 24/7 Emergency Plumbing, Water and Fire Damage Restoration (registered trade name of Frontline Fire & Flood).

> 24/7 restoration services in Lakewood, WA.

Frontline Fire & Flood (Frontline Fire & Flood) is a professional restoration contractor serving Lakewood, WA and surrounding areas since 2014. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (253) 200-0503 · Email: service@frontlinefireflood.com.
